items.briefing:
Quest Apartment Hotels has confirmed a customer data breach caused by a vulnerability in a third-party system, meaning guest personal information may have been exposed. If you've stayed at Quest recently, monitor your accounts for suspicious activity. Separately, the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) is warning that a tool called N-able N-central is being actively exploited in Australia — organisations using this IT management software should apply patches immediately. Professional services firms are also being reminded they face the highest volume of cyber intrusions, so staff in those sectors should stay especially alert.

A new report also highlights that internal fraud remains a significant blind spot for many businesses, with employees sometimes being the source of financial or data theft. **Practical tip:** Regularly review who has access to sensitive systems and financial data in your organisation — removing unnecessary access is one of the simplest ways to reduce risk from both inside and outside threats.

featured.title: Merchants face internal fraud blind spot, report warns
